title: P0 attach/list/detach session lifecycle is per-process ephemeral — real agent telemetry can NEVER reach the DB: `rabbit-hole attach --pid X` creates a fresh in-memory collector, prints "Attached to PID X / Session ID Y / Collection active" then EXITS; the session exists in no database (verified: searched both rh.db and ~/.rabbit-hole/rabbit-hole.db), so `list` shows nothing, `status` never sees it, and `detach <id>` fails "Error: session ... not found" (reproduced exit 1). Two attaches to the same PID produce two different session IDs (reproduced). Even with root+eBPF the probes die with the process. `serve` runs the real pipeline (collector→classifier→store) but has NO way to start a session (no attach flag/API; grep StartSession in cmd/express = 0 hits) — the demo stream is the ONLY flow source in the whole binary. The README Quick Start attach→status→detach loop is theater; the core Collect promise (zero-SDK attach to a real agent) is unreachable. Fix: add a daemon-side attach path — either `attach` hands the session to a running `serve` (HTTP/gRPC attach endpoint + persistence via SessionManager) or attach becomes the long-running foreground collector writing to the DB; then wire the same path into serve for eBPF sessions. PASS: attach --pid X (root or --no-ebpf) → session visible in `list`/`status`/`GET /api/v1/sessions` and removable via `detach X`, across separate CLI invocations.
reasoning: Dogfood run 2026-08-08 (real use): attach printed success then exited; session ID found in no DB; detach of the printed ID returned 'session not found'; two attaches to PID 1 yielded two different session IDs. attach.go opens no storage (grep storage = 0 hits); pipeline only wired in serve.go:121; express has no attach/StartSession endpoint.
worker_summary: DF-001 fixed (worker deepseek-v4-flash, commit 7545df4, 16 files +1311/-53): daemon-side HTTP attach/detach (POST /api/v1/sessions/attach, /{id}/detach) via SessionManager; list/status read DB; same-PID -> 409; GAP-001 preflight preserved; live-verified attach->list->status->API->detach across invocations

title: P1 Chat cannot answer natural-language questions — flagship Express promise broken: `chat "What did the agent do in the last hour?"` (CLI and API, real gemma3:4b via Ollama) returns canned "I couldn't find any matching activity for your query." with 0 flows, while 140+ flows exist incl. live ones published every 3s (reproduced 3x, 3-11s LLM latency each). Direct keyword "write_file" works (15 flows, real LLM summary). Root causes: (a) internal/express/chat.go:41 calls SearchFlows(ctx, Query, Limit) ONLY — the Categories/Outcomes the LLM emits (parsed at chatmodel.go:180-191) are silently discarded; (b) SearchFlows has no time-range parameter at all (sqlite.go:326), so "last hour"/"at 3am" can never filter — "What did helios do at 3am?" (README/specs promise) is structurally impossible; (c) small local models translate questions into generic keyword strings FTS5 can't match. Fix: thread Categories/Outcomes/SessionID/TimeRange from the translated SearchRequest into the store query, add TimeRange to SearchFlows, and have TranslateQuery emit a time window. PASS: `curl POST /api/v1/chat {"Message":"What did the agent do in the last hour?"}` against seeded/live data returns Flows>0 with recent flows.
reasoning: Dogfood run 2026-08-08: 3 NL phrasings all returned 'couldn't find any matching activity' against a live demo stream; direct keyword returned 15 flows. Read chat.go + chatmodel.go: handler drops structured filters; store has no time filter.
